title: Narrow and Deep: An Ontology Tower as the Knowledge of an LLM Agent for an Industrial Equipment System
abstract: arXiv:2610.11768v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are beginning to operate industrial energy equipment, and what they get right depends on what they are told about the plant. Established building ontologies name many kinds of points across many sites, whereas an industrial equipment system needs few entities with much knowledge about each. This study proposes the ontology tower, a narrow-and-deep ontology of a single equipment system whose knowledge deepens in two ways: through quantities derived from the measured points by physical relations, and through lessons from the operating journal incorporated as knowledge nodes. On a real low-humidity air-handling test plant operated daily through a programmable logic controller, agents received a text projected from its tower in a preregistered evaluation of nine tasks replayed from the plant's records, using four open-weight models from 9 to about 750 billion parameters. translated_title: 窄而深：作为工业设备系统LLM智能体知识的本体塔
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体开始操作工业能源设备，而它们的正确操作取决于所获得的关于工厂的信息。既有的建筑本体在众多场所中命名了多种类型的测点，而工业设备系统需要的实体很少，但对每个实体的知识却需十分深入。本研究提出了“本体塔”，这是一种针对单一设备系统的窄而深本体，其知识通过两种方式深化：一是通过物理关系从测量点推导出的物理量，二是将运行日志中的经验教训作为知识节点纳入其中。在一套通过可编程逻辑控制器（PLC）日常运行的真实低湿度空气处理试验装置上，智能体接收了从其本体塔投影出的文本，并在一项预先注册的评估中，对从装置记录中回放的九项任务进行了测试，使用了四个参数量从90亿到约7500亿的开源权重模型。这些知识提升了智能体的……（原文此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“本体塔”——一种针对单一工业设备系统的窄而深本体，通过物理关系推导量与运行日志经验两种方式深化知识，显著提升了LLM智能体操作真实工业设备的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the "ontology tower," a narrow-and-deep ontology for a single industrial equipment system that deepens knowledge through physically-derived quantities and lessons from operating journals, substantially improving LLM agents' ability to operate real industrial equipment.
